task_description: Implement Phase 6: Jobs and Scheduler for Doot DSL compiler. SQLite-backed job queue, in-process async worker pool, job declaration/dispatch DSL syntax, cron-style scheduler, retry logic, and stuck job detection. All with comprehensive tests.

verification.summary: 63 tests pass in test_jobs.nim covering queue creation, enqueue, claim, worker execution, retry logic, stuck job detection, scheduler, interval parsing, parser integration. All existing tests also pass (70 lexer, 67 parser, 19 schema, 33 query, 96 template). Semantic review APPROVED after 2 rounds - 5 correctness issues found in v1 were fixed, v2 APPROVED with only 2 non-blocking style notes.
